question:
**Direction: Parts of the given sentence have been given as options. One of them contains a spelling error. Select the option that rectifies the error.**

According to a study by BBC across 66 different sports, five out of every six sports now give equal prize money to men and women at the world champonship level.
solution: The correct answer is **"championship."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is** "championship."** • The error in Option 4 is that it is missing the letter **"i".** • The word **"championship" **refers to a competition or series of competitions to determine the best player or team in a particular sport or game. (सर्वश्रेष्ठ खिलाड़ी या दल का ढूँढ़ने के लिए आयोजित स्‍पर्धा या स्‍पर्धाएँ) • **Example**: *The world **championships**__ will be held in Scotland next year.* • The correct usage of the word in the sentence is** "world championship level"**, which means the highest level of competition in a particular sport or game. • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1 (wumen)** is a misspelling of the word** "women",** which refers to female human beings. (स्‍त्री, औरत, महिला, नारी) • **Option 2 (diferent)** is a misspelling of the word **"different", **which means not the same as something else. (भिन्‍न, अलग प्रकार का, एक जैसा नहीं) • **Option 3 (akcross) **is a misspelling of the word **"across", **which means from one side to the other side of something. (एक ओर से दूसरी ओर; आर-पार) 34:Ta56, The correct answer is** "messy and untidy."**
